active_continuity: The Myriad-Poison Ring is in Jin Taekyung's Inventory after he stole it from the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
The Divine Physician is alive but severely injured after resisting the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and safe in the treatment room unless the Western Heaven Demon Lord's redirected attack reaches it.
The Heavenly Power Demon transferred three jiazi of internal energy to Jin Taekyung and asked him to kill the Western Heaven Demon Lord.
Jin Taekyung can physically contend with the Western Heaven Demon Lord but remains inferior in martial skill.
Jin Taekyung is rushing to intercept the Western Heaven Demon Lord's attack on the treatment room.
The underground prison remains in the process of collapsing.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord claims that the Tang Clan, Qingcheng, and Emei have been destroyed, but this remains unconfirmed.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord serves an unidentified Lord of Heaven as one of four loyal servants.
Cheongpung remains engaged in his confrontation with First Fiend.
open_questions: What will be the outcome of Jin Taekyung's attempt to block the Western Heaven Demon Lord's attack on the treatment room?
Can the Divine Physician survive his injuries and continue protecting Jeok Cheongang?
Who is the Lord of Heaven, and what is the intended purpose of the Myriad-Poison Ring?
What is the actual outcome of the attacks on the Tang Clan, Qingcheng, and Emei?
Can Cheongpung survive or escape his confrontation with First Fiend?
